definitions.explanation: a medium-sized towel, typically about 34×80 cm, used for drying the face and hands

examples.japanese: フェイスタオル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{洗面所|せんめんじょ}→洗面所：17618_senmenjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧フェイスタオル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けておいた。
examples.english: I hung a face towel in the washroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧フェイスタオル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: This face towel feels nice against the skin and is pleasant to dry your face with.

notes:
The standard medium-sized towel in Japanese households, used primarily for drying the face and hands. In Japan, towels are categorized by size more precisely than in many Western countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フェイスタオル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to dry one's face with a face towel
- フェイスタオル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to replace a face towel
- {今治|いまばり}フェイスタオル: Imabari face towel (a famous towel-producing region)

JAPANESE TOWEL SIZES:
- ⟦ハンドタオル→ハンドタオル：27930_handotaoru⟧ / ⟦タオルハンカチ→タオルハンカチ：28155_taoruhankachi⟧: hand towel (approx. 25×25 cm) — pocket-sized
- フェイスタオル: face towel (approx. 34×80 cm) — the most common household towel
- ⟦バスタオル→バスタオル：04511_basutaoru⟧: bath towel (approx. 60×120 cm) — large towel for after bathing

USAGE:
In Japanese daily life, フェイスタオル is the most frequently used towel size. Many Japanese people prefer using a フェイスタオル even after bathing, rather than a full-sized ⟦バスタオル→バスタオル：04511_basutaoru⟧, as it dries faster and takes up less space in the laundry.
